summary: Frontend-only testing of the new role-based single-platform workspace. Cleared localStorage, verified header role-selector, all 5 role dashboards (citizen/government/university/industry/ngo) with proper titles, nav labels, and action buttons. Executed full end-to-end shared-state flow: submitted a new challenge as Citizen (Water & Sanitation, Ranchi), verified it as Government, then confirmed the same challenge appeared in University/Industry/NGO lists and Express Interest / Offer Support / Back This Challenge actions all worked with correct toggled states. Role persisted across reload via jmib_role localStorage. Regression: /, /explore, /dashboard, /impact all load without console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Workspace.jsx uses dynamic Tailwind class `md:grid-cols-${stats.length}` which won't be picked up by Tailwind JIT; a static inline gridTemplateColumns style already overrides it so functionally OK, but the dynamic class line can be removed to avoid confusion.
seed_data_creation: Submitted one TEST challenge titled 'TEST Contaminated tubewell water in village' (Water & Sanitation, Ranchi) during flow verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All role-based workspace features working. Role selector, per-role nav labels, verify/express/offer/back actions all functional. Shared data confirmed across roles. Role persistence via localStorage jmib_role works. Regression clean.
